subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Bachelor's Rose Ceremony Formula
description: One-minute skill: The Bachelor's Rose Ceremony Formula.

hook.text: One person, 25 suitors, roses as weapons. The Bachelor turned dating into an elimination sport and audiences loved it.

buildup.text: The show thrives on manufactured romance.

discovery.text: Producers engineer drama by controlling information. They decide who gets one-on-one time and who gets ignored.

twist.text: The show's success rate for lasting relationships is terrible.

climax.text: The Bachelor's Rose Ceremony Formula matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: A dating show with a failure rate became an empire.

quiz.question: What role do producers play in creating drama on The Bachelor?
options: They control information and engineer situations to maximize conflict
They choose the winner in advance
